content: Selling into the EU? Three regulations carry real deadlines: EUDR deforestation rules (Dec 2026 / mid-2027 by company size), empowered-consumer claim rules, packaging rules. Free SME guide — how to check if you're in scope, find your role, and read your deadline off role plus size: https://galaxyaek7-del.github.io/openclaw-factory/customer_site/guide-eudr-sme-deadlines.html — full method free, no email needed. We also sell a $149 manual briefing; the guide stands alone. Regulatory info, not legal advice.
